# Civic Watch

Civic Watch tracks public works projects and flags the risky ones, so citizens can see where money is stuck.

Live demo: https://civic-watch.vercel.app

![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-green)

## How it works
Each project gets a risk score from its delay, cost overrun and missing documents.

Demo video limit for the hackathon: 2 minutes.
